marker_reviews.reason: The dynamic markers are the catalog-driven DROP INDEX loop and the definition-based keeper assertion over duplicate plain-index twins. No sidecar check kind expresses that combined outcome: catalog_absence can name one absent object, but the keeper assertion is definition-based because keeper names diverge across environments, and exact_row_count cannot see pg_index definitions. The durable proof is the in-migration assertion (raises if any keeper is missing after the drops) plus the PR preview proof and issue #6410 acceptance.
